map.：算法（四法可选）：重力 Δg=0.0419·Δρ·h（mGal，×10 得 g: : Algorithm (four methods): gravity Δg=0.0419·Δρ·h (mGal, ×10 gives g.u.); magnetic ΔT=200·κ·H·V/z³ (nT), magnetization M=κ·H; electrical array coefficient K=2πa, apparent resistivity ρa=K·ΔV/I; seismic velocity v=d/t, reflection depth H=v·t/2. Each method forward-models in real time from the chosen parameters, for comparison with measured curves.
map.：例（重力）：剩余密度差 Δρ=0.3g/cm³、厚度 h=100m → Δg=: : Example (gravity): residual density contrast Δρ=0.3g/cm³, thickness h=100m → Δg=0.0419×0.3×100=1.257mGal (=12.57g.u.). Example (electrical): electrode spacing a=10m, potential difference ΔV=0.05V, current I=1A → K=2π×10=62.83m, ρa=62.83×0.05/1=3.14Ω·m, characteristic of a low-resistivity layer.
map.正演和实测对不上怎么办？: What if the forward model does not match measurements?
map.正演是理想模型（均匀板状体/点源），实测受围岩、地形与噪声影响。先检查参数（密度: Forward modelling is an ideal model (uniform plate / point source), while measurements are affected by host rock, topography and noise. First check whether the parameters (density contrast, depth, array) are reasonable, then invert or run 2D forward modelling; single-point formulas only check order of magnitude.
map.g.u. 和 mGal 怎么换？: How do g.u. and mGal convert?
map.1 g.u.（重力单位）=0.1 mGal，工具已自动换算（Δg×10）。国内物: 1 g.u. (gravity unit) = 0.1 mGal; the tool converts automatically (Δg×10). Domestic geophysical reports commonly use g.u., while international literature uses mGal; the two differ by a factor of 10.
